name: Kittl
summary: Design platform combining image and vector generation, editing tools, mockups and curated assets.
description: Kittl is a browser-based design platform. It combines image, vector and video generation with professional editing tools, mockups, background removal and a library of assets and templates, and provides workflows for merch and marketing. A creative agent and an MCP integration let AI agents work inside Kittl. It is free to start; paid plan prices did not load during this check.

howToUse.title: Open Kittl
howToUse.description: Open Kittl and choose Start Creating. It is a browser-based design platform and it is free to start.

howToUse.title: Generate, then edit
howToUse.description: Generate an image, a vector, or a video, then keep editing with the professional tools: mockups, background removal, and the library of assets and templates.

howToUse.title: Run a merch or marketing workflow
howToUse.description: Use a workflow for merch or marketing, or open the creative agent and build launch-ready assets in one chat.

howToUse.title: Let another agent work inside Kittl
howToUse.description: Use the MCP integration when an AI agent should work inside Kittl. Paid plan prices did not load during the check, so open Pricing on Kittl before you pay.
